datasheet_identity.title: US2A THRU US2M SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Fig. 3 was digitized for the dotted US2J-US2M family curve; the plot is typical and its current axis is logarithmic.
Fig. 4 was digitized for the Tj = 25 degC lower curve; reverse-voltage x values are percentages of the rated peak reverse voltage, not volts.
The electrical-characteristics table also specifies IR2 = 200 uA at VR = VDC and TA = 100 degC; the required reverse-current field records the separate TA = 25 degC maximum IR1 value.
Maximum ratings: VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A, IFSM = 50.0 A at 8.3 ms half-sine; Tstg and Tj = -55 to +150 degC.
No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current characteristic is specified; the 1000 V VDC/VRRM rating is not treated as a measured breakdown point.
The single tabulated forward-voltage point is retained without invented intermediate values.
